actions.reason: Avoid building pair-count dictionaries during encoding. The encode merge choice only depends on the lowest-ranked adjacent pair that is present in the merges table, not on pair counts, so scanning adjacent pairs directly preserves the selected merge while reducing allocation and dictionary update work.
